observations.behavior: Adds Project Secret API Key authentication to the Experiments ViewSet.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows service accounts (PSAKs) with experiment:read scope to authenticate and retrieve experiments without using personal user credentials.

observations.behavior: Restricts PSAK permissions on this viewset to read-only actions only; other methods are not allowed even if broader scopes exist.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents a project secret API key from performing write or lifecycle operations on experiments, enforcing least privilege for warehouse-sync use cases.

observations.behavior: Defines team-level burst and sustained rate limits specifically scoped to PSAK requests.
observations.posthog_connection: Imposes shared resource protection by capping aggregate request rates across all keys belonging to a single team, preventing one overzealous sync account from exhausting shared capacity.

observations.limitations: The implementation relies on existing synthetic-user handling and routing access control. Tier 2 is assigned because while it establishes a new capability, its systemic risk reduction and broader architectural dependency changes are not demonstrated in this chunk alone. No tier 3 evidence of cross-component propagation or critical-path failure prevention.

review.reason: Adds bounded, substantive capability: authenticated service accounts can perform experiment reads with explicit permission and rate limiting. This could support warehouse ingestion workflows without exposing personal credentials. Not tier 3 as no wider systemic change or multi-module dependency restructuring is shown.
review.posthog_relevance: Could enable warehouse connectors to read experiment definitions using dedicated, revocable, non-personal credentials; relevant if PostHog supports warehouse exports including A/B test metadata.
review.uncertainty: Assessment depends on whether the rest of the repository already had similar patterns for other resources; this chunk does not show those dependencies.
